mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We currently have overcast skies near Badger Ridge Middle School with a temperature of 34 degrees, feeling like 26. A waning gibbous moon is shining through the clouds overnight.

In city news, candidate information packets are now available for the 2027 Spring Election, which will feature seats in all four City of Verona Aldermanic Districts. Candidates must file their paperwork with the City Clerk by January 5th, 2027, and nomination paper signatures can begin circulating on December 1st.

There are great local events happening today, including The Crafty Fair at ART House 360 from 10 AM to 4 PM, as well as live music today at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and Lake Lou-ee. Looking ahead to next week, you can enjoy trivia nights at Hop Haus and The Bogey Factory.

In police news, on Wednesday, November 4th, officers responded to a two-vehicle crash in a parking lot on East Verona Avenue, resulting in a Fitchburg woman being arrested for O W I with a passenger under 16 in the vehicle.
Culver's opens today at 10:00 AM. Stop by to try today's delicious flavor of the day, Mint Cookie.
